title: The Hand of God and the Goal of the Century (Maradona, Mexico 1986)
post: He scored with his hand. Four minutes later: the Goal of the Century. ⚽ How many defenders could you dribble past? #football #maradona #worldcup #handofgod #story

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"; word times from the API's own alignment

phrases.text: He scored with his hand. Four minutes later, he scored the goal of the century.
phrases.say: [dramatic] He scored with his hand. [excited] Four minutes later... he scored the goal of the century.

phrases.text: Mexico City, 1986. World Cup quarter-final, Argentina against England, four years after the Falklands War.
phrases.say: Mexico City, nineteen eighty-six. World Cup quarter-final... Argentina against England... four years after the Falklands War.

phrases.text: Minute fifty-one: an England midfielder loops the ball back toward his keeper.
phrases.say: Minute fifty-one... an England midfielder loops the ball back toward his keeper.

phrases.text: Maradona, seven inches shorter, jumps and punches it in.
phrases.say: [intense] Maradona... seven inches shorter... jumps... and punches it in.

phrases.text: The referee doesn't see it. Goal.
phrases.say: The referee doesn't see it. [surprised] Goal.

phrases.text: Later he said: a little with the head of Maradona, and a little with the hand of God.
phrases.say: Later he said... [smirking] a little with the head of Maradona... and a little with the hand of God.

phrases.text: Four minutes later, from his own half:
phrases.say: [serious] Four minutes later... from his own half:

phrases.text: Beardsley. Reid. Butcher. Fenwick. Shilton. Goal!
phrases.say: [building excitement] Beardsley. Reid. Butcher. Fenwick. Shilton... [shouting] Goal!

phrases.text: The commentator screamed: cosmic kite, what planet did you come from?
phrases.say: The commentator screamed... [shouting] Cosmic kite! What planet did you come from?

phrases.text: A week later, Argentina were world champions.
phrases.say: A week later... Argentina were world champions.

phrases.text: And Steve Hodge, who looped that ball back, swapped shirts with Maradona after the game.
phrases.say: [conspiratorial] And Steve Hodge... who looped that ball back... swapped shirts with Maradona after the game.

phrases.text: Argentina had bought those shirts in a Mexico City shop days earlier.
phrases.say: Argentina had bought those shirts in a Mexico City shop... days earlier.

phrases.text: In 2022, that shirt sold for $9.3 million.
phrases.say: In twenty twenty-two... that shirt sold for... [excited] nine point three million dollars.

phrases.text: So, how many defenders could you dribble past?
phrases.say: [curious] So... how many defenders could you dribble past?
